name: cowork-marketplace
description: Skill plugins for Cowork — professional design (cowork-work), utilities (cowork-utils), and personal wellness (cowork-life). Legacy cowork-skills bundle available for backward compatibility.

plugins.name: cowork-work
plugins.description: Professional UX and Figma — currently includes figma-design. More design skills added as they pass package review (see PACKAGE-MATRIX.md).

plugins.name: cowork-utils
plugins.description: Helpers and cross-cutting tools — client-resources, defuddle-n8n, raindrop-bookmarks, plan-workflow, skill-creator, deep-research, continual-learning, deploy-artifact, image-generator, plan-write, plan-implement, send-message.

plugins.name: cowork-life
plugins.description: Personal wellness — currently includes endurance-coach (running and triathlon). meal-planning and morning-planner coming after review.

plugins.name: cowork-skills
plugins.description: Legacy bundle — original six skills only. Use cowork-work + cowork-utils + cowork-life for new installs.
